protocol.r2_ablation: Per-patch fixed query permutation of local CNN vectors; coordinates/tokens unchanged.
protocol.population: Existing optimized-on N06/N08 128-patch monitor is the residual training set, not the 25000-patch detector population. Fixed 480-patch development validation, no test access.
protocol.schedule: Fixed 2000 updates; early checkpoints descriptive, no validation-selected winner or extension.
protocol.supervision: Original matched-pair CE, all negatives under cap9999, ratio upsampling0.15; identical orientation/balancing seeds. No R07 mining.
protocol.decision_gate: N08 completed negative selection result does not establish a token information deficit. Normal conditional AP is already ~0.978; residual FP and near-nonadjacent confusion leave a small testable target. Only a bounded frozen comparison is justified, not a large architecture campaign.
protocol.confirmation_gate: R2 must improve final conditional/all-retained AP and graph F1 against R0/R1 in both seeds, show loss of benefit with image shuffling, and avoid worsened cycles or early-only gains. Subject intervals must support the improvement; otherwise no unfrozen confirmation.

ap_note: Identical candidates, labels and prevalence within each split/tolerance/seed. Conditional and all-retained are separate populations.
ce_note: Reported Hungarian CE uses symmetric pair probabilities on all assigned pairs, without ratio duplication: a fixed diagnostic distinct from original randomized-order ratio-balanced training CE.
